capabilities.name: lookup_savings_balance
capabilities.description: Look up a member on Horizon Core and return the savings balance shown on the detail screen.

inputs.name: memberId
inputs.description: Member number. On the Northline variant the same value is entered in the field labeled Account ID.

outputs.name: savingsBalance
outputs.description: Savings balance text shown beside Savings balance, including the dollar sign.

variants.description: Northline Credit Union configuration of Horizon Core. Apply this overlay to a base capability: prefix every path, replace field labels, and dismiss the branch notice before continuing.

capabilities.name: open_sub_account
capabilities.description: Open a sub-account for a member and stop on Submit so a person can confirm it.

inputs.name: product
inputs.description: Visible product name, such as Holiday club.

outputs.name: submissionStatus
outputs.description: Status text after a person submits the confirmation.
